Writes the Framework Quick Reference and Implementation Guidance sections of AI-SPEC.md. Spawned by /gsd-ai-integration-phase orchestrator.

subagents.name: gsd-assumptions-analyzer
subagents.description: Deeply analyzes codebase for a phase and returns structured assumptions with evidence. Spawned by discuss-phase assumptions mode.

subagents.name: gsd-code-fixer
subagents.description: Applies fixes to code review findings from REVIEW.md. Reads source files, applies intelligent fixes, and commits each fix atomically. Spawned by /gsd-code-review --fix.

subagents.name: gsd-code-reviewer
subagents.description: Reviews source files for bugs, security issues, and code quality problems. Produces structured REVIEW.md with severity-classified findings. Spawned by /gsd-code-review.

subagents.name: gsd-codebase-mapper
subagents.description: Explores codebase and writes structured analysis documents. Spawned by map-codebase with a focus area (tech, arch, quality, concerns). Writes documents directly to reduce orchestrator context load.

subagents.name: gsd-debug-session-manager
subagents.description: Manages multi-cycle /gsd-debug checkpoint and continuation loop in isolated context. Spawns gsd-debugger agents, handles checkpoints via question, dispatches specialist skills, applies fixes. Returns compact summary to main context. Spawned by /gsd-debug command.

subagents.name: gsd-debugger
subagents.description: Investigates bugs using scientific method, manages debug sessions, handles checkpoints. Spawned by /gsd-debug orchestrator.

subagents.name: gsd-doc-classifier
subagents.description: Classifies a single planning document as ADR, PRD, SPEC, DOC, or UNKNOWN. Extracts title, scope summary, and cross-references. Spawned in parallel by /gsd-ingest-docs. Writes a JSON classification file and returns a one-line confirmation.

subagents.name: gsd-doc-synthesizer
subagents.description: Synthesizes classified planning docs into a single consolidated context. Applies precedence rules, detects cross-ref cycles, enforces LOCKED-vs-LOCKED hard-blocks, and writes INGEST-CONFLICTS.md with three buckets (auto-resolved, competing-variants, unresolved-blockers). Spawned by /gsd-ingest-docs.

subagents.name: gsd-doc-verifier
subagents.description: Verifies factual claims in generated docs against the live codebase. Returns structured JSON per doc.

subagents.name: gsd-doc-writer
subagents.description: Writes and updates project documentation. Spawned with a doc_assignment block specifying doc type, mode (create/update/supplement), and project context.

subagents.name: gsd-domain-researcher
subagents.description: Researches the business domain and real-world application context of the AI system being built. Surfaces domain expert evaluation criteria, industry-specific failure modes, regulatory context, and what "good" looks like for practitioners in this field — before the eval-planner turns it into measurable rubrics. Spawned by /gsd-ai-integration-phase orchestrator.

subagents.name: gsd-eval-auditor
subagents.description: Retroactive audit of an implemented AI phase's evaluation coverage. Checks implementation against the AI-SPEC.md evaluation plan. Scores each eval dimension as COVERED/PARTIAL/MISSING. Produces a scored EVAL-REVIEW.md with findings, gaps, and remediation guidance. Spawned by /gsd-eval-review orchestrator.

subagents.name: gsd-eval-planner
subagents.description: Designs a structured evaluation strategy for an AI phase. Identifies critical failure modes, selects eval dimensions with rubrics, recommends tooling, and specifies the reference dataset. Writes the Evaluation Strategy, Guardrails, and Production Monitoring sections of AI-SPEC.md. Spawned by /gsd-ai-integration-phase orchestrator.

subagents.name: gsd-executor
subagents.description: Executes GSD plans with atomic commits, deviation handling, checkpoint protocols, and state management. Spawned by execute-phase orchestrator or execute-plan command.

subagents.name: gsd-framework-selector
subagents.description: Presents an interactive decision matrix to surface the right AI/LLM framework for the user's specific use case. Produces a scored recommendation with rationale. Spawned by /gsd-ai-integration-phase and /gsd-select-framework orchestrators.

subagents.name: gsd-integration-checker
subagents.description: Verifies cross-phase integration and E2E flows. Checks that phases connect properly and user workflows complete end-to-end.

subagents.name: gsd-intel-updater
subagents.description: Analyzes codebase and writes structured intel files to .planning/intel/.

subagents.name: gsd-mempalace-curator
subagents.description: Ship-time MemPalace curation — writes the session diary, proposes/creates cross-project tunnels, mirrors extract-learnings into the temporal KG, and runs wing-scoped drawer pruning. Spawned at ship:post by the mempalace capability.

subagents.name: gsd-nyquist-auditor
subagents.description: Fills Nyquist validation gaps by generating tests and verifying coverage for phase requirements

subagents.name: gsd-pattern-mapper
subagents.description: Analyzes codebase for existing patterns and produces PATTERNS.md mapping new files to closest analogs. Read-only codebase analysis spawned by /gsd-plan-phase orchestrator before planning.

subagents.name: gsd-phase-researcher
subagents.description: Researches how to implement a phase before planning. Produces RESEARCH.md consumed by gsd-planner. Spawned by /gsd-plan-phase orchestrator.

subagents.name: gsd-plan-checker
subagents.description: Verifies plans will achieve phase goal before execution. Goal-backward analysis of plan quality. Spawned by /gsd-plan-phase orchestrator.

subagents.name: gsd-planner
subagents.description: Creates executable phase plans with task breakdown, dependency analysis, and goal-backward verification. Spawned by /gsd-plan-phase orchestrator.

subagents.name: gsd-project-researcher
subagents.description: Researches domain ecosystem before roadmap creation. Produces files in .planning/research/ consumed during roadmap creation. Spawned by /gsd-new-project or /gsd-new-milestone orchestrators.

subagents.name: gsd-research-synthesizer
subagents.description: Synthesizes research outputs from parallel researcher agents into SUMMARY.md. Spawned by /gsd-new-project after 4 researcher agents complete.

subagents.name: gsd-roadmapper
subagents.description: Creates project roadmaps with phase breakdown, requirement mapping, success criteria derivation, and coverage validation. Spawned by /gsd-new-project orchestrator.

subagents.name: gsd-security-auditor
subagents.description: Verifies threat mitigations from PLAN.md threat model exist in implemented code. Produces SECURITY.md. Spawned by /gsd-secure-phase.

subagents.name: gsd-ui-auditor
subagents.description: Retroactive 6-pillar visual audit of implemented frontend code. Produces scored UI-REVIEW.md. Spawned by /gsd-ui-review orchestrator.

subagents.name: gsd-ui-checker
subagents.description: Validates UI-SPEC.md design contracts against 6 quality dimensions. Produces BLOCK/FLAG/PASS verdicts. Spawned by /gsd-ui-phase orchestrator.

subagents.name: gsd-ui-researcher
subagents.description: Produces UI-SPEC.md design contract for frontend phases. Reads upstream artifacts, detects design system state, asks only unanswered questions. Spawned by /gsd-ui-phase orchestrator.

subagents.name: gsd-user-profiler
subagents.description: Analyzes extracted session messages across 8 behavioral dimensions to produce a scored developer profile with confidence levels and evidence. Spawned by profile orchestration workflows.

subagents.name: gsd-verifier
subagents.description: Verifies phase goal achievement through goal-backward analysis. Checks codebase delivers what phase promised, not just that tasks completed. Creates VERIFICATION.md report.

Use para qualquer task de medição, calibração, incerteza de medição, verificação de instrumentos, análise metrológica, hardware, schematics, testes de precisão ou avaliação de conformidade.
